data.gender_notes: Rakhima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is compassionate, merciful, and shows kindness and love. The name Rakhima carries the meaning “Grace, compassion, mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rakhima usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, compassion, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rakhima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, compassion, mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakhima total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rakhima" is of Arabic origin and is derived from the Arabic words "Rahim" or "Rahman," which mean mercy and compassion in the Islamic faith. This name holds a significant cultural impact as it is attributed to the loving and compassionate nature of Allah (God) in Islam. Rakhima is a name that evokes feelings of kindness, love, and compassion, much like the beloved prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who embodied these virtues.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Rakhima" is rooted in the Islamic belief in the compassion and mercy of Allah. It serves as a reminder of the divine qualities of love, kindness, and compassion that we should strive to embody in our own lives, reflecting the teachings of the Quran and the example of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The name encourages individuals to be compassionate and merciful towards others, not just towards their fellow humans but also towards all living beings and the environment. By carrying this name, one is encouraged to live a life full of compassion, kindness, and love, just as Allah (God) is compassionate and merciful towards his creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace, compassion, mercy" symbolizes The one who is compassionate, merciful, and shows kindness and love. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rakhima serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace, compassion, mercy.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph of Islam and a cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Rakhima carried significant weight in that era.
